session_summary: The session focused on managing Mrs. Georgescu's diabetes and foot wound. A referral to surgery was made, and a plan for medication management and follow-up tests was outlined.

proposed_actions.title: Book Surgery Appointment

proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I will take care of the appointment, I'll call tomorrow morning.

proposed_actions.description: Ana should prepare a weekly medication box for Mrs. Georgescu by Sunday evening.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Ana, please prepare it for the whole week on Sunday evening.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Lab Tests

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Follow-Up Appointment

decisions: Referral to surgery for the foot wound.
Schedule lab tests for hemoglobin A1c and urine test.
